title: "Jay M"
---

Your exploratory data analysis of the team datasets go here.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
np <- read_csv("../data/raw/parks.csv")
np_species <- read.csv("../data/raw/species.csv")
```



```{r}
np_species %>%
  filter(!is.na(Family), Family != "") %>%
  distinct(Family, Scientific.Name) %>%
  count(Family, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 15) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = forcats::fct_reorder(Family, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#00008B", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.3, size = 3.5, color = "#34483A") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "The Most Diverse Species Families",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Unique Species",
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
np_species %>%
    filter(!is.na(Occurrence), Occurrence != "") %>%
  count(Occurrence, sort = TRUE) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = forcats::fct_reorder(Occurrence, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#00008B") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Species Occurrence Status",
    x = "Occurrence Status",
    y = "Number of Records"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
np_species %>%
    filter(!is.na(Abundance), Abundance != "") %>%
```
